title: EOS capability profile
description: Evidence-earned, versioned and expiring authority record. Profile level tunes Express thresholds, the free decision band and review sampling; it never affects tier floors or non-waivable floors. The checker rejects profile changes without an operator authorisation entry: agents cannot expand their own authority.

benchmark_runs.description: run_id values from the benchmark ledger (benchmark-result.schema.json).

pass_rate.description: Null when no sampled review has run. A rate of 1.0 against an n of 0 reads as a perfect record and makes regression_rule.thresholds.sampled_review_pass_rate_min unable to fire; null says the threshold is not evaluable, which is the true statement.

note.description: Why the numbers are what they are, for a reader who would otherwise take a null or a zero at face value.

period.description: The window the evidence covers, for example 2026-02/2026-08.

authorised_by.description: The operator. Promotion needs new evidence plus separate operator authorisation.

authorisation_note.description: Anything about this authorisation a reader needs and the fields cannot carry: what was back-filled, what ordering the dates hide, what the level is due to be re-argued against. Re-dating a record to make it look tidy loses the fact; a note keeps it.

expires.description: Default six months after authorisation. An expired profile falls back to conservative.

on_breach.description: Crossing a threshold regresses the profile one level automatically, logged.

evaluable.description: False when at least one threshold has nothing to test against, so the rule cannot fire on it. A rule recorded as live while half of it is untestable reads as protection that is not there.

not_evaluable_reason.description: Which threshold cannot be evaluated and why, and what the rule still fires on meanwhile.
